veg.n: Connie's wedding antipasto with marinated artichokes
veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled, serve at room temperature

steps.text: Arrange the artichokes, chargrilled eggplant, provolone and olives on a platter.
Pile the roast capsicum alongside, drizzle with olive oil and add cracked pepper.
Leave out for a few minutes so it comes to room temperature before serving.

veg.make_ahead: Rice up to 1 day ahead, chilled on a tray; fry just before serving

steps.text: Cook the rice in the vegetable stock with the saffron, stirring, until thick. Stir in the cheese, spread on a tray and chill, ideally overnight.
Brown the plant-based mince with the peas and passata until thick and dry. Cool.
Wrap golf-ball portions of cold rice around a spoon of filling and a cube of mozzarella.
Roll in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil at 175C in batches until deep gold and hot through, then drain.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 2 hours ahead; press just before serving

steps.text: Fry the smoked tofu in the olive oil until browned, then add the garlic and orange juice and toss until sticky.
Split the rolls and smear the cut sides with mustard.
Layer with the tofu, Swiss cheese and pickle.
Brush the tops with melted butter.
Press in a heavy pan over medium heat with a second pan on top, about 3 minutes a side, until the cheese melts.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Leave the rockmelon at room temperature for an hour.
Halve, deseed, cut into 12 long wedges and cut off the skin.
Drape each wedge with a strip of eggplant, add flaky salt, pepper and a drizzle of olive oil just before serving.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the provolone and arrange the board up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; tear the bread on the night

steps.text: Cut the provolone into thick batons.
Arrange the eggplant, smoked tofu and provolone on a board.
Put the pepperoncini and marinated mushrooms in small bowls beside the board.
Tear the Italian bread by hand and set it next to the board.

veg.n: Bagel crisps with schmear and cured beetroot
veg.make_ahead: Crisps up to 2 days airtight; schmear and beetroot up to 1 day chilled

steps.text: Peel the beetroot and slice it paper thin. Toss with the salt, sugar, dill and lemon juice and leave to cure for 30 minutes.
Slice the bagels into thin rounds and brush with olive oil.
Bake at 180C until crisp.
Beat the cream cheese with chives and lemon zest.
Serve the crisps with the schmear and the cured beetroot on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Batter up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled; fry just before serving

steps.text: Pat the hearts of palm dry and flake them with a fork into rough shreds.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt, water, garlic, coriander and nori into a loose batter and fold in the hearts of palm.
Fry wide flat spoonfuls in 180C oil in batches until golden and lacy.
Drain and finish with flaky salt.

veg.make_ahead: Slice and score the mushrooms up to 4 hours ahead, chilled; sear and sauce on the night

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms into thick coins and score a criss-cross on each face.
Heat the olive oil until very hot, sear the mushrooms until golden on both sides, then add the garlic and chilli.
Add the wine, bubble for a minute, then swirl in the butter and parsley and season with salt.
Serve in the pan with crusty bread for the juices.

veg_af.make_ahead: Slice and score the mushrooms up to 4 hours ahead, chilled; sear and add the verjuice on the night

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms into thick coins and score a criss-cross on each face.
Heat the olive oil until very hot, sear the mushrooms until golden on both sides, then add the garlic and chilli.
Add the verjuice and water, bubble for a minute, then swirl in the butter and parsley and season with salt.
Serve in the pan with crusty bread for the juices.

veg.make_ahead: Cook up to 2 hours ahead and reheat in a hot oven

steps.text: Grill the vegetarian sausages over medium-high heat, turning, until blistered and hot through.
Toss the capsicum and onion in oil and grill until charred at the edges.
Slice them thick and thread onto toothpicks with the capsicum and onion.
Serve with the hot mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Soak up to 2 hours ahead; fry just before serving

steps.text: Slice the mushroom stems into thick rings and the caps into strips, then soak in the buttermilk for 30 minutes.
Mix the semolina, flour and plenty of salt.
Drain the mushrooms and toss in the flour mix.
Fry in 190C oil in batches for 90 seconds each until pale gold.
Salt and serve with lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Stuff up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled; grill just before serving

ingredients.item: cup mushrooms, stalks removed and finely chopped

steps.text: Brush the mushroom cups with olive oil and bake gill side up at 200C for 8 minutes.
Mix the butter with the chopped stalks, garlic, capsicum, parsley and breadcrumbs.
Fill each mushroom with a spoon of the mix and scatter over the smoked almonds.
Grill for 4 minutes until crisp.

veg.make_ahead: Make the butter up to 1 day ahead; grill just before serving

steps.text: Brush the mushroom cups with olive oil and bake gill side up at 200C for 8 minutes.
Blitz the spinach, parsley, spring onions, butter, breadcrumbs and liqueur.
Settle the mushrooms gill side up on a tray of rock salt and spoon in the butter.
Grill on high for 3 minutes until bubbling and serve hot with lemon.

veg_af.make_ahead: Make the butter up to 1 day ahead; grill just before serving

steps.text: Brush the mushroom cups with olive oil and bake gill side up at 200C for 8 minutes.
Blitz the spinach, parsley, spring onions, butter, breadcrumbs, fennel seeds and lemon juice.
Settle the mushrooms gill side up on a tray of rock salt and spoon in the butter.
Grill on high for 3 minutes until bubbling and serve hot with lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Chill the bechamel overnight; crumb up to 4 hours ahead and fry to serve

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the extra butter over high heat until dry and browned, about 8 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 2 minutes, then whisk in the warm milk and cook until very thick.
Stir in the mushrooms and nutmeg, spread on a tray, cover and chill overnight.
Roll into 16 logs, dip in egg and then breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil at 180C in batches until golden and serve with lime.

veg.make_ahead: Risotto up to 1 day ahead; fry just before serving

steps.text: Cook the rice in the vegetable stock to a firm risotto, stir in the cheese and cool completely.
Roll into 16 balls around cubes of mozzarella.
Roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Heat the neutral oil to 180C and fry for 4 minutes in batches.
Warm the passata and serve for dipping.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, keep chilled, serve at room temperature

ingredients.item: jar roast peppers, torn into strips

steps.text: Fold the eggplant and smoked tofu onto a long board and tuck the stuffed sweet peppers in between.
Add the artichokes and roast peppers, and dress the bocconcini with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Slice the loaf and serve alongside so everyone builds their own.

veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms need to marinate overnight, serve at room temperature

steps.text: Blanch the mushrooms in boiling water for 1 minute and drain well.
Toss with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and parsley. Refrigerate covered overnight.
Serve on a platter with the chargrilled eggplant, olives and artichokes.

veg.make_ahead: Soak up to 2 hours ahead; fry just before serving

steps.text: Slice the mushroom stems into thick rings and the caps into strips, then soak in the buttermilk for 30 minutes.
Mix the semolina, flour and plenty of salt.
Drain the mushrooms and toss through the flour mix.
Fry in 190C oil in batches for 90 seconds each until pale gold.
Salt and serve with lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, cover with damp paper towel and keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, then mash with mayonnaise and cress.
Butter the bread. Make 2 sandwiches with cucumber, 2 with the egg and 2 with roast capsicum and dill on cream cheese.
Cut off the crusts and cut each into 3 fingers.

veg.make_ahead: Top up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled; grill to serve

steps.text: Sit the mushrooms gill side up in a baking dish with the water and bake at 200C for 8 minutes.
Mix the breadcrumbs, garlic, oregano, cheese and olive oil and top each mushroom.
Grill for 3 minutes until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the rockmelon into 12 skinless wedges and drape with the chargrilled eggplant.
Blitz the basil with olive oil and salt.
Drain the bocconcini, dress with the basil oil and pepper, and serve beside the melon.

veg.make_ahead: Pâté up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the butter over high heat until all the liquid has gone and they are well browned.
Add the shallots and thyme, then the brandy, and let it bubble off.
Blitz with the walnuts and soft butter until silky, season and press into a dish.
Pour over the clarified butter and chill for 4 hours.
Toast the rye and serve with the mushroom spread.

veg_af.make_ahead: Pâté up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the butter over high heat until all the liquid has gone and they are well browned.
Add the shallots and thyme, then the verjuice and water, and let it bubble off.
Blitz with the walnuts and soft butter until silky, season and press into a dish.
Pour over the clarified butter and chill for 4 hours.
Toast the rye and serve with the mushroom spread.

veg.n: Hollywood party blini with couscous caviar
veg.make_ahead: Couscous up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; top just before serving

steps.text: Boil the pearl couscous for 8 minutes, drain, cool and toss with the beetroot juice, soy and olive oil.
Warm the blini at 180C for 5 minutes.
Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, a spoon of the couscous and chives.
Serve straight away on a tray.

veg.make_ahead: Components up to 1 day ahead; fill just before serving

steps.text: Toss the chickpeas with half the olive oil and the smoked paprika and roast at 200C for 20 minutes until crisp.
Fry the smoked tofu in the rest of the oil until crisp. Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and chop.
Dice the avocado and tomatoes.
Fill the lettuce leaves with everything, scatter over the blue cheese and spoon over the vinaigrette.

veg_af.n: Brown Derby Cobb salad cups (vegetarian, alcohol-free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Components up to 1 day ahead; fill just before serving

steps.text: Toss the chickpeas with half the olive oil and the smoked paprika and roast at 200C for 20 minutes until crisp.
Fry the smoked tofu in the rest of the oil until crisp. Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and chop.
Dice the avocado and tomatoes.
Whisk the extra virgin olive oil, vinegar and Dijon into a dressing.
Fill the lettuce leaves with everything, scatter over the blue cheese and spoon over the dressing.

veg.make_ahead: Chill the bechamel up to 1 day ahead; fry to serve

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the extra butter over high heat until dry and browned, about 8 minutes.
Melt the butter for the sauce, cook the flour for 1 minute and whisk in the milk until very thick.
Stir in the mushrooms and nutmeg, spread on a tray and chill for 3 hours.
Shape into 20 logs and roll in egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in the neutral oil at 180C in batches until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the tomato juice, lemon juice, soy sauce and seasonings up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; add the vodka and shake with ice to order

ingredients.item: celery salt and pepper, to taste

steps.text: Put a share of vodka, tomato juice, lemon, soy sauce, hot sauce, celery salt and pepper in a tin with ice.
Pour back and forth between two tins 5 times.
Strain over fresh ice and add a celery stick. Repeat for each drink.

veg_af.make_ahead: Mix the tomato juice, pickle brine, lemon juice, soy sauce and seasonings up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; shake with ice to order

ingredients.item: celery salt and pepper, to taste

steps.text: Put a share of tomato juice, pickle brine, lemon, soy sauce, hot sauce, celery salt and pepper in a tin with ice.
Pour back and forth between two tins 5 times.
Strain over fresh ice and add a celery stick. Repeat for each drink.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, serve at room temperature

ingredients.item: roasted red capsicums, cut in strips

steps.text: Arrange the eggplant, stuffed peppers and provolone on a board.
Add the capsicum strips and artichokes.
Tear the loaf at the table.

veg.make_ahead: Soak up to 1 hour ahead; fry to serve

steps.text: Slice the mushroom stems into thick rings and the caps into strips, then soak in the milk for 20 minutes.
Toss in the flour mixed with semolina and salt.
Fry in the oil at 190C for 1 minute a batch.
Warm the marinara and serve with lemon.

veg.n: Lemon and parsley risotto with king oyster mushrooms (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; slice the mushrooms, dice the zucchini and onion and chop the garlic and parsley up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms into coins, dice the zucchini, dice the onion, chop the garlic and chop the parsley.
Sear the mushrooms in 2 tbsp of the olive oil over high heat until golden, then set aside.
Warm the vegetable stock in a saucepan. Soften the onion and garlic in the rest of the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the carnaroli rice and toast for 2 minutes, then pour in the white wine and stir until it is absorbed.
Add the hot vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 16 minutes until the rice is nearly tender, adding the zucchini for the last 5 minutes.
Stir the mushrooms back in, take off the heat and stir through the butter, the parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve straight away, no cheese.

veg_af.n: Lemon and parsley risotto with king oyster mushrooms (vegetarian, alcohol-free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; slice the mushrooms, dice the zucchini and onion and chop the garlic and parsley up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; measure the verjuice and water on the night

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms into coins, dice the zucchini, dice the onion, chop the garlic and chop the parsley.
Sear the mushrooms in 2 tbsp of the olive oil over high heat until golden, then set aside.
Warm the vegetable stock in a saucepan. Soften the onion and garlic in the rest of the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the carnaroli rice and toast for 2 minutes, then pour in the verjuice and water and stir until absorbed.
Add the hot vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 16 minutes until the rice is nearly tender, adding the zucchini for the last 5 minutes.
Stir the mushrooms back in, take off the heat and stir through the butter, the parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve straight away, no cheese.

veg.make_ahead: Best served straight away; blitz the spinach and basil paste and soak the saffron up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; grate the cheese ahead and cook the risotto on the night

steps.text: Heat the vegetable stock in a saucepan. Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp of hot water. Blitz the baby spinach and basil leaves with a splash of the vegetable stock to a smooth paste.
Soften the onion in 40g of the butter for 5 minutes, add the arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes, then add the white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the hot vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 17 minutes until the rice is just tender.

Split the risotto into three pans over low heat. Stir the spinach and basil paste into the first, the cheese and the last 30g butter into the second, and the passata with the saffron and its water into the third.
Spoon the green, white and red risotto side by side on each plate.

veg_af.make_ahead: Best served straight away; blitz the spinach and basil paste and soak the saffron up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; grate the cheese ahead and cook the risotto on the night

steps.text: Heat the vegetable stock in a saucepan. Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp of hot water. Blitz the baby spinach and basil leaves with a splash of the vegetable stock to a smooth paste.
Soften the onion in 40g of the butter for 5 minutes, add the arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes, then add the verjuice and water and stir until absorbed.
Add the hot vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 17 minutes until the rice is just tender.

Split the risotto into three pans over low heat. Stir the spinach and basil paste into the first, the cheese and the last 30g butter into the second, and the passata with the saffron and its water into the third.
Spoon the green, white and red risotto side by side on each plate.

veg.n: Bronx devilled eggs with smoky mushroom crisps
veg.make_ahead: Eggs up to 1 day, keep chilled; top just before serving

steps.text: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel.
Fry the shiitake in the oil over medium heat until crisp, toss with the soy and a pinch of the paprika, then drain.
Halve the eggs and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Pipe or spoon back into the whites. Top with the mushroom crisps, the rest of the paprika and chives.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the hearts of palm into thick rounds, season with the salt and chill.
Mix the tomato sauce with horseradish and the juice of 1 lemon.
Serve the hearts of palm on ice with the sauce and wedges from the other lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Grill the vegetarian sausages until browned and hot through, then slice into chunks.
Fry the capsicums and onions in oil until soft and sweet.
Toss with the vegetarian sausage and a splash of red wine vinegar.

veg.make_ahead: Make the gravy ahead; fry the chips to serve

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips, soak for 30 minutes and dry well.
Fry in the oil at 150C for 6 minutes, then at 190C until crisp.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for a minute, whisk in the mushroom stock and soy and simmer for 5 minutes into gravy.
Pile the fries on a tray, pour over the gravy, top with mozzarella and grill for a minute.

veg.make_ahead: Bake the biscuits up to 1 day ahead, keep covered and rewarm in a 160C oven; make the sage gravy just before serving

ingredients.item: self-raising flour, extra for the gravy

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Grate the frozen butter into the 300g self-raising flour with a pinch of salt and toss to coat.
Stir in the buttermilk to make a soft dough, fold it over on itself three times, pat out 2cm thick and cut 8 biscuits.
Bake the biscuits on a lined tray until risen and golden.
Squeeze the vegetarian sausages out of their skins, or chop them finely, and brown in the extra butter with the sage, breaking them up as they cook.
Stir in the extra flour for a minute, then add the milk a little at a time and simmer until thick, with plenty of black pepper. Split the biscuits and spoon the gravy over.

veg.n: Boston chowder cups with oyster mushrooms (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled; reheat gently

steps.text: Dice the smoked tofu, onion, celery and potatoes.
Fry the smoked tofu in the oil until crisp, then sweat the onion and celery in the same pan until soft.
Add the potatoes, vegetable stock, kombu and thyme and simmer until the potato is tender, then lift out the kombu.
Stir in the mushrooms and simmer for 3 minutes, then add the cream and warm through. Serve in cups with the crackers.

veg.make_ahead: Crush the biscuits up to 3 days ahead, airtight; melt the chocolate and toast the marshmallows on the night

steps.text: Melt the dark chocolate in a bowl over simmering water and crush the digestive biscuits in a bag with a rolling pin.
Push 2 vegetarian marshmallows onto each bamboo skewer.
Toast over a gas flame or under a hot grill, turning often, until the outside blisters.
Dip in the melted chocolate, then in the crushed biscuits, and eat while warm.

veg.make_ahead: Best toasted and eaten straight away; nothing to make ahead

steps.text: Lay 8 digestive biscuits on a tray and put a square of milk chocolate on each.
Toast the vegetarian marshmallows over a flame until golden and melting, or sit one on each chocolate square and put the tray under a hot grill for 30 seconds.
Press the remaining biscuits on top and eat straight away.

veg.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the agar into 250ml of the lemonade in a saucepan and leave for 5 minutes.
Bring to the boil, stirring, and simmer for 2 minutes, then take off the heat and stir in the rest of the lemonade.
Pour into a jelly mould with the raspberries.
Chill in the fridge until set, about 2 hours.
Dip the mould in hot water, turn out and put on something upbeat.

veg.make_ahead: Roll up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Roll the dough into a thin rectangle and spread with the sauce.
Cover with the plant-based pepperoni and mozzarella, roll up tightly from the long side, slice into 12 rounds and place cut side up on a lined tray.
Bake at 220C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 2 hours ahead, grill to serve

steps.text: Split the bagels and spread each half with pizza sauce.
Top with the mozzarella, mushrooms and olives.
Grill until bubbling and serve hot.

veg.n: Thanksgiving sliders with maple roast pumpkin
veg.make_ahead: Stuffing squares and pumpkin up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Make the stuffing mix as the packet says and press into a tray. Peel the pumpkin, slice it thinly and toss with the oil and maple syrup on a second tray.
Bake both at 190C until the stuffing is crisp and the pumpkin is tender, then cut the stuffing into 8 squares.
Toast the slider buns. Fill each bun with pumpkin, cranberry sauce and a square of stuffing.

veg.make_ahead: Best eaten straight away

steps.text: Mix 1 tbsp of the oil with the soy, smoked paprika and maple syrup, brush over the eggplant and grill on a tray, turning once, until crisp at the edges.
Fry the smoked tofu in the remaining oil until golden.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise. Slice the tomatoes and shred the lettuce.
Build 4 triple-deckers with tofu, eggplant, lettuce and tomato. Cut into quarters and pin each with a toothpick.

veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Whip the cream.
Heat the milk with the chocolate and most of the maple syrup, whisking until smooth and steaming.
Stir in the coffee, or leave it out for the kids.
Pour into 4 mugs and top with cream, vegetarian marshmallows, a drizzle of maple syrup and crushed candy cane.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours ahead, wrapped and chilled

steps.text: Mash the butter with the Dijon and spread over the bread.
Fill with the smoked tofu and Swiss cheese.
Cut off the crusts, cut into quarters and wrap in wax paper.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours ahead, wrapped and chilled

steps.text: Split the rolls lengthwise.
Layer the eggplant, roast capsicum, provolone, lettuce and tomato.
Dress with the oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
Press down firmly, then cut each hero into 6 wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Carrot up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Blanch the carrot ribbons in boiling water for 1 minute, drain and cool.
Toss with the olive oil, lemon juice, soy and smoked paprika and leave for 20 minutes.
Split and toast the bagels.
Spread each half thickly with cream cheese, then top with the carrot, capers, onion and small sprigs of dill. Cut each half in two to share.

veg.make_ahead: Beetroot up to 1 day ahead, warm to serve

steps.text: Toss the beetroot with the oil, coriander seeds, pepper, smoked paprika, sugar and soy.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until the edges darken.
Spread the rye with mustard, pile the beetroot high on half the slices and close. Cut in half and serve with a pickle each.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Soften the shallot in a little butter, then fry the mushrooms over high heat until dry and browned.
Add the cognac and flame it off carefully.
Blitz the mushrooms, shallot, walnuts and thyme leaves with most of the remaining butter, softened, until smooth, then pack into a dish.
Melt the last of the butter, pour it over the top and chill until set.
Serve with cornichons and warm baguette.
Soften the shallot in a little butter, then fry the mushrooms over high heat until dry and browned.
Add the verjuice and let it bubble off.
Blitz the mushrooms, shallot, walnuts and thyme leaves with most of the remaining butter, softened, until smooth, then pack into a dish.
Melt the last of the butter, pour it over the top and chill until set.
Serve with cornichons and warm baguette.

veg.make_ahead: Keeps 5 days in an airtight jar in the fridge

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms lengthways 5mm thick.
Mix the soy, vinegar, sugar, paprika, chilli and garlic powder and toss through the mushrooms.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Pat dry, lay on racks over trays and dry at 75C with the oven door slightly open for about 3 hours, until leathery but still bendy.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Cut the tofu into 24 small fingers and fry in the oil until golden.
Toss with the soy, smoked paprika and nori, then tip into a shallow tin with the oil.
Chop the parsley.
Lay a piece of tofu on each cracker, squeeze over lemon, add a drop of hot sauce and some parsley. Serve on the tin lids.

veg.make_ahead: Best eaten straight away

steps.text: Mix the black vinegar, soy sauce and chilli oil for dipping.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and pan-fry the dumplings until the bottoms crisp.
Add the water, cover straight away and steam until cooked through (or the packet time), then remove the lid and let the water evaporate.
Serve with the dipping sauce.

veg.n: Plaza Hotel hearts of palm cocktail
veg.make_ahead: Hearts of palm and sauce up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the hearts of palm into thick rounds, toss with the juice of half the lemon and chill.
Mix the tomato sauce, horseradish, juice of the other half lemon and a dash of soy.
Fill 4 glasses with shredded iceberg, pile the hearts of palm on top and spoon the sauce in the middle.

veg.n: Harlem fried oyster mushrooms and waffles
veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms soak up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Soak the mushroom clusters in the buttermilk and salt for 30 minutes.
Dredge in the flour mixed with paprika and make the waffle batter.
Fry the mushrooms in oil at 175C in batches for about 4 minutes, until deep golden and crisp, then drain.
Cook the waffles in a waffle iron. Warm the honey with the hot sauce and drizzle over the mushrooms on the waffles.

veg.make_ahead: Best eaten the day they are made

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the extra butter with the thyme and salt until golden, then cool.
Warm the baguette at 200C and cool slightly.
Split lengthways and spread both sides generously with the cultured butter. Lay the mushrooms inside, add cornichons and pepper.
Close, press firmly and cut into 12 pieces. Serve with Dijon on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 2 hours ahead, bake to serve

steps.text: Roll the dough thin and cut 16 rounds with a glass.
Top each with a spoon of sauce, a pinch of mozzarella and a slice of plant-based pepperoni.
Bake at 230C until golden underneath.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the chilli salt up to 1 week ahead; stir the tomato juice, lime and soy together up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and top with lager to serve

ingredients.item: limes, juiced, with some cut into wedges

steps.text: Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate.
Rub a lime wedge around each of 4 glass rims and dip in the chilli salt.
Add ice, a good squeeze of lime juice, the tomato juice, hot sauce and soy, dividing evenly.
Top each with a cold lager, stir gently and slip the glasses into small paper bags.

veg_af.make_ahead: Mix the chilli salt up to 1 week ahead; stir the tomato juice, lime and soy together up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and top with alcohol-free lager to serve

ingredients.item: limes, juiced, with some cut into wedges

steps.text: Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate.
Rub a lime wedge around each of 4 glass rims and dip in the chilli salt.
Add ice, a good squeeze of lime juice, the tomato juice, hot sauce and soy, dividing evenly.
Top each with a cold alcohol-free lager, stir gently and slip the glasses into small paper bags.

veg.n: Bagel paperweight bites with chive schmear (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Halve the bagels and toast until golden.
Beat the cream cheese with the milk, chives and pepper.
Mix the sesame, poppy seeds, garlic flakes and salt for the bagel seasoning.
Pipe or spread the schmear thickly onto the bagels. Top with smoked tofu, capers and seasoning.

veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days, keep chilled

ingredients.item: tinned young jackfruit in brine, drained

steps.text: Squeeze the jackfruit dry and shred it with two forks, cutting away any tough core.
Mix the hoisin, honey, soy and five spice, toss through the jackfruit and leave for 30 minutes.
Spread on a tray brushed with the neutral oil and roast at 200C for 25 minutes, stirring halfway, until sticky and catching at the edges.
Steam the bao buns until soft and fill with the jackfruit.

veg.n: Salt and vinegar rice paper crackling
veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours in an airtight container

steps.text: Break the rice paper into palm-sized pieces.
Heat the oil to 190C and fry a few pieces at a time for a few seconds until puffed and white, then drain on paper towel.
While still hot, flick over 1 tbsp of the malt vinegar with your fingertips and dust with the salt.
Sprinkle with the flaky salt mixed with the last 1 tsp of malt vinegar. Serve with pickled onions and hot mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Make the dip up to 3 days ahead in a jar in the fridge; cook the dumplings from frozen on the night, they are best hot and crisp

steps.text: Mix the soy, black vinegar and ginger for dipping.
Fry the dumplings flat side down in oil.
Add the water, cover and steam.
Uncover and fry again until crisp underneath.
Serve straight from the pan with the dip.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Press the wonton wrappers into a lightly oiled mini muffin tin. Bake at 180C until crisp.
Brown the plant-based mince in oil, add the onion and cook until soft.
Stir in the chilli powder, tomatoes and beans. Simmer until thick.
Spoon into the baked cups, top with cheddar and return to the oven to melt.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Warm the vegetarian cocktail sausages in simmering water for 3 minutes, then drain.
Melt the butter with the honey, Dijon, sugar and soy in a frying pan.
Add them and toss over medium heat until sticky and glazed.
Serve on toothpicks with cocktail onions.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the capsicum and cut the dough rounds up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; top and bake on the night

steps.text: Roll the dough thin and cut 12 rounds.
Spread with sauce and top with mozzarella.
Slice the roast capsicum into thin strips and lay them in a crosshatch like a manhole grate.
Bake at 230C until bubbling.

veg.make_ahead: Lentils up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; assemble just before serving

steps.text: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until just tender, drain, cool and dress with the soy, olive oil and lemon juice.
Spread each cracker with crème fraîche.
Top with a spoon of the lentils and a few chives just before serving so the crackers stay crisp.

veg.make_ahead: Mignonette up to 1 day; sear the mushrooms up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Mix the shallots, vinegar and plenty of cracked pepper. Rest to let the flavours settle.
Sear the mushrooms in the oil over high heat for 2 minutes, season with the salt and nori, then chill.
Lay the mushrooms on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette in a small bowl with a spoon.

veg.make_ahead: Make the day before

steps.text: Whisk 1 tsp of the agar and half the sugar into the coconut milk in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour into four glasses and chill until set, about 1 hour.
Steep the pea flowers in the hot water for 10 minutes and strain. Whisk in the rest of the agar and sugar, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes.
Cool for 10 minutes, then pour gently over the set coconut layer.
Chill until firm, about 1 hour, then top with the gummy lollies.

veg.make_ahead: Blitz the tofu paste up to 1 day ahead, chilled; spread, cut and fry just before serving

steps.text: Blitz the tofu, mushrooms, egg white, ginger, spring onion and salt to a thick paste.
Spread on the bread and press in the sesame seeds.
Cut into triangles.
Fry in oil at 180C until golden, then drain.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Pat the hearts of palm dry and cut into thick rounds.
Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds.
Mix the mayonnaise and tomato sauce.
Top each cucumber round with a piece of hearts of palm, a dot of sauce and a dill sprig. Serve cold.

veg.n: Wall Street hearts of palm cakes
veg.make_ahead: Cakes shaped up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Squeeze the hearts of palm dry and shred with a fork.
Mix with the nori, mayonnaise, egg, Dijon, parsley and breadcrumbs.
Shape 12 small cakes and chill.
Pan-fry in butter, turning once, until golden.
Serve with lemon wedges and tartare sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Butter the bread.
Layer the smoked tofu, cheddar and pickles across four slices and top with the other slices.
Trim off the crusts and cut each sandwich into three fingers.
Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate until serving.

veg.n: Haloumi cocktail for the whole hotel
veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day ahead; fry the haloumi up to 2 hours ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the haloumi in the oil over medium-high heat until golden on all sides, squeeze over half the lemon, then cool.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and a squeeze from the other lemon half.
Serve on shredded iceberg in glasses, with sauce and a dusting of paprika.

veg.make_ahead: Lentils up to 2 days ahead; assemble just before serving

steps.text: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until just tender, drain, cool and dress with the soy, olive oil and lemon juice.
Warm the blini on a tray at 180C.
Top each with crème fraîche, then a spoon of the lentils and chives.
Serve straight away while warm.

veg.make_ahead: Cut and toss the paneer in the cornflour up to 1 day ahead and keep it covered in the fridge. Bake and glaze just before serving.

steps.text: Cut the paneer into thick fingers and toss with the cornflour, olive oil and salt.
Bake on a lined tray at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Melt the butter with the honey, sweet chilli sauce, chilli flakes, lime zest and lime juice.
Toss the paneer through the glaze and scatter with the coriander.
